project.name: acme
project.summary: pnpm + Turborepo monorepo: Next.js app (App Router) in apps/web/, Express API in apps/api/, Prisma (postgresql) in packages/db/, shared zod schemas in packages/contracts/

suites.name: web
suites.command: cd apps/web && pnpm exec vitest run {target}

suites.name: db
suites.command: cd packages/db && pnpm exec vitest run {target}

tests.e2e_command: cd apps/web && pnpm exec playwright test

data.check_command: cd packages/db && pnpm exec prisma validate && pnpm exec prisma migrate status

house_rules: Only packages/db imports PrismaClient; apps call its repository functions.
Request and response shapes come from packages/contracts; don't redefine them in an app.
Changing packages/contracts means running the dependants' tests too (the contracts suite does this via turbo).
